personality_one_liner: Highly readable, durable, and distraction-free utility interface optimized for fast and accurate factory floor data entry.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets (min 48pt) and single-column mobile-friendly form layouts. Clear separation between form sections.

dont's: Avoid glassmorphism. This is a factory floor utility app where clarity and high contrast are mandatory. Use solid surfaceSecondary instead of glass.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure, quick access using Name and PIN.
screens.layout: Large hero image (sewing factory) with gradient scrim at top, floating single-column form at the bottom (thumb zone). PIN input should use large numeric keypad.

screens.name: Home / Beranda
screens.purpose: Overview of today's logged activities and quick access to start new entries.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty clipboard. Text: 'Belum ada aktivitas hari ini.'

screens.layout: Top section: Today's summary (total pieces, total hours). Middle section: Two large cards (Primary Actions) - 'Input Aktivitas Utama' and 'Input Aktivitas Lain'. Bottom: List of recent entries for today.

screens.name: Form Input Aktivitas Utama
screens.purpose: Log main production tasks (cutting, sewing) with an option to embed other activities.

states.error: Inline field errors with red borders and helper text.

screens.layout: Single-column form. Labels above fields. Large native dropdowns for Master Data (Jenis Produk, Motif, Aktivitas). Native time pickers for Mulai/Selesai. Include a sticky 'Simpan' CTA at the bottom. A prominent button 'Tambah Aktivitas Lain di waktu ini' to dynamically add an interruption inside this block.

screens.name: Form Input Aktivitas Lain
screens.purpose: Log non-production time separately (praying, eating, toilet).
screens.layout: Simplified single-column form. Dropdown for activity type. Time pickers. Sticky bottom CTA.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Aggregated view and export capability for managers.

states.empty: No data found for selected date/team.

screens.layout: Filter bar at the top (Date, Team, Tailor). Summary stats (Total Hours, Total Output). Scrollable list of worker performance. A sticky FAB or bottom bar to 'Export to Spreadsheet'.

login_hero.alt: Row of sewing machines in a textile factory

instructions_to_main_agent: Design specifically for factory workers: touch targets must be at least 48x48pt. Padding should be generous.
Form UX: Use single-column layouts with labels ABOVE inputs. Do NOT use floating labels. Required fields must be clearly marked.
For all numeric inputs (Time, PIN, Batch count), use a monospace font if possible (e.g., Space Mono or JetBrains Mono) to make scanning numbers easier, though Plus Jakarta Sans handles numbers well.
Implement the 'Aktivitas Lain' (Interruption) feature inside the 'Aktivitas Utama' form as an expandable sub-form or a bottom sheet that appends the interruption to the current main activity payload.
Use standard native pickers for time. Pre-fill the current date and time where appropriate.
Keep contrast extremely high. Disable glassmorphism completely; use solid surfaceSecondary for cards, bottoms sheets, and headers.
Ensure 'Simpan' (Save) buttons are sticky at the bottom of the screen (above the safe area) during form entry, so users do not have to scroll to find them.
Never use blue, purple, or indigo. Use the defined Moss Green (#2E5A40) for primary actions and Terracotta (#B84C3D) for destructive/cancel/errors.
Ensure haptic feedback is added to all primary buttons and form submissions.
